fusions.name: Gnaw and Run
fusions.desc: Flings a gnawed scrap that deals 4 damage and sickens the target [Diseased] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm Flush
fusions.desc: Looses 5 gnawed scraps at once, spread wide, each dealing 4 damage and stunning the target for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Scurry for Cover
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 50% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dying Burrow
fusions.desc: When your health falls low, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
